The bid submitted by the banned bidder shall be summarily rejec ted. 2.19.24 Contracts concluded before the issue of the banning order shall, not be affected by the banning order. 2.19.25 Banning shall automatically be extended to all Allied firms of the Contractor. In case of Joint venture/ Consortium is banned all partners will also stand debarred for the period specified in the Banning Order. The names of all partners should be clearl y specified in the “Banning order”. 2.19.26 Banning in any manner does not impact any other contractual or other legal rights of NPCIL. 2.19.27 Banning under the provisions of Banning of Business Dealings of NPCIL is applicable only for NPCIL. 2.19.28 Definition of Allied Firm: Allied Firm means all concerns which come within the sphere of effective influence of the banned firm.
